questions.question: Which treaty was suspended by Pakistan in retaliation to India's withdrawal from the Indus Waters Treaty?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shimla Agreement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Pakistan suspended the Shimla Agreement in retaliation to India's withdrawal from the Indus Waters Treaty.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Shimla Agreement was signed between India and Pakistan after the 1971 war to restore peace and resolve issues bilaterally.**
 
• The agreement led to the establishment of the Line of Control (LoC) in Kashmir, replacing the previous ceasefire line.
 
• It also facilitated the formal recognition of Bangladesh and the release of 93,000 Pakistani prisoners of war.
 
• Pakistan’s suspension of the Shimla Agreement came in response to India’s move to withdraw from the Indus Waters Treaty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Lahore Declaration__

 __
 
• Signed in - 1999
 
• Between - India and Pakistan
 
• Aimed to strengthen peace and security, and resolve Kashmir conflict
 
 
 
• Tashkent Agreement__
 __
 
• Signed in - 1966
 
• Between - India and Pakistan
 
• Focus - Restoration of territories captured during the 1965 war
 
 
 
• Karachi Agreement__
 
 
• Signed in - 1949
 
• Between - India and Pakistan
 
• Focus - Ceasefire line in Kashmir post-1947 war

questions.question: What is the name of the ISRO satellite scheduled for launch on May 18, 2025, aboard PSLV-C61?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**EOS-09**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ISRO to launch earth imaging satellite from Sriharikota on May 18.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**ISRO** will launch its **101st satellite, EOS-09**, on **May 18, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The launch will use the **PSLV-C61** rocket.

 
 
• 
 
**EOS-09** is a follow-on to the earlier **RISAT-1 mission**.

 
 
• 
 
It is an **Earth observation satellite** with **C-band synthetic aperture radar (SAR)**.

 
 
• 
 
It can capture **high-resolution images** in **all weather conditions, day or night**.

 
 
• 
 
The satellite strengthens **surveillance at borders and coasts**.

 
 
• 
 
Useful for **anti-terror operations**, it can detect **ingress and suspicious movements**.

 
 
• 
 
ISRO is also preparing to launch the **NASA-ISRO SAR (NISAR)** satellite on **GSLV-F16**.

 
 
• 
 
**NISAR** uses **dual-band radar** (from **NASA** and **ISRO**) to study **ecosystems, surface changes, and disasters**.

 
 
• 
 
These missions enhance **India’s space-based monitoring and disaster management** capabilities.

questions.question: Har Shikhar Tiranga culminates with the successful ________________ expedition.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Kanchenjunga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

**Har Shikhar Tiranga”** mission actually **culminated with the successful expedition to Mt. Kangchenjunga.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Har Shikhar Tiranga mission** successfully culminated after climbing **Kanchenjunga** (height: **8586 m**).
 
• The mission was led by **Col Ranveer Singh Jamwal**, Director of **NIMAS** and team leader of the expedition.
 
• A **five-member team** hoisted the **Indian national flag (Tiranga)** on the **highest peak of every state** in India.
 
• Team members included **Col R S Jamwal**, **Naib Subedar Tsewang Chosgail**, **NB Sub Nehpal Singh**, **Havaldar Kewal**, and **Havaldar Sushil Kumar**.
 
• The expedition overcame **blizzards** and other challenges on **Kanchenjunga**, one of India’s toughest peaks.
 
• The mission aligned with **PM Narendra Modi’s vision of Meri Maati Mera Desh**, collecting soil from mountains of all **28 Indian states**.
 
• It was the **first-ever expedition** in India covering **30,000 km** in one year to climb the **highest points of all 28 states**.

questions.question: In which country did the World Health Organisation (WHO) declare a polio outbreak?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Papua New Guinea.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The World Health Organisation (WHO) declared a polio outbreak in Papua New Guinea, urging an immediate vaccination campaign.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **WHO has declared a polio outbreak in Papua New Guinea after detecting samples of the virus in healthy children during routine screenings.**
 
• The samples were found in Lae, a coastal city in the northeast of Papua New Guinea.
 
• Polio is a highly infectious disease primarily affecting children under five, spreading through contact with infected faeces or respiratory droplets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Polio__

 __
 
• A highly infectious viral disease that can cause paralysis, particularly in children under the age of five.
 
• Transmission occurs through contaminated food or water, or by direct contact with infected faeces or respiratory droplets.
 
 
 
• Vaccination Campaign__
 __
 
• WHO is urging immediate vaccination to control the outbreak and prevent further spread of the disease.
 
 
 
• Papua New Guinea__
 
 
• A country in the southwestern Pacific, where polio has re-emerged despite global efforts to eradicate it.

• **The survey covered 34,950 households and 1,42,065 persons across rural and urban India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Unified Payments Interface (UPI):**__ A real-time payment system developed in India that facilitates inter-bank transactions via mobile devices.
 
• __**Comprehensive Modular Survey: Telecom (CMS:T):**__ A national survey conducted by the Ministry of Statistics covering telecom usage, mobile and internet penetration.
 
• __**Smartphone Penetration:**__ Percentage of population owning smartphones, indicating digital connectivity and access to mobile-based services like UPI.
 
• __**Internet Access:**__ Availability of internet connectivity at homes, crucial for digital transactions and online services.

questions.question: How many Anubhav Awards will be conferred in 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Anubhav Awards, 2025 to be conferred by the Union Minister of State, Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare, Dr. Jitendra Singh on 18.08.2025 under National Anubhav Awards Scheme, 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Anubhav Awards 2025** will be conferred by the **Union Minister of State**, **Dr. Jitendra Singh**, on **August 18, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The awards will be given under the **National Anubhav Awards Scheme, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
A total of **5 Anubhav Awards** and **10 Jury Certificates** will be awarded from **1459 write-ups** published by **42 Ministries/Departments/Organizations**.

 
 
• 
 
This year, for the **first time**, **CPSEs (Central Public Sector Enterprises)** and **PSBs (Public Sector Banks)** have participated and made it to the **final list**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Anubhav platform** was launched in **March 2015** by the **Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare**, under the **Prime Minister’s directions**, to share experiences of retiring/retired government employees.

 
 
• 
 
The **Annual Awards Scheme** was introduced to incentivize and encourage **retiring/retired employees** to submit their experiences through **write-ups**.
